paragraphs: Eichah Rabbah 4:3: he and Rabbi Tanchum say in the name of Rabbi Acha.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman’s supplied Eichah Rabbah 4:3 is retained. The named Midrash Rabbah TE chapter 4 paragraph beginning “The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord” explicitly gives Rabbi Elazar Batzraa and Rabbi Tanchum in the name of Rabbi Acha. That corresponding occurrence supports the full Rabbi titles locally. The earlier TE 4:3 paragraph was a nonmatch; the later matching paragraph is not proof of printed numbering or correction history. The source heading בוצראה and the digital בצראה are preserved without Hebrew repair or a new identity binding.
